License or cost: Open source; Apache 2.0. Hosting and external model costs are separate.
Model-specific: Supports multiple LLM providers; individual screening integrations may use separate models or services.
PII masking: Configurable PII detection and masking rails; detector integrations/dependencies must be reviewed.
Other capabilities: Input/output/retrieval/dialog/tool rails; topic, jailbreak, moderation, hallucination and custom flows.
Banking fit / caveat: Strong open-source candidate; validate Presidio/GLiNER dependencies, data flow, fail-closed behavior, and Gemini/LangGraph integration.

License or cost: Open-source Apache 2.0 core; DetectPII validator MIT. Hosting and model costs are separate.
PII masking: DetectPII can anonymize using Presidio; local mode is available.
Other capabilities: Input/output validators, custom validators, structured-output/schema validation, correction/reask actions.
Banking fit / caveat: Good developer framework, but it is not a full agent-security platform; PII masking uses Presidio underneath.

License or cost: Commercial service; free account for evaluation. Production pricing depends on plan/usage; SaaS, Edge, and Private Cloud options.
PII masking: Recipes can redact/replace PII in prompts and responses.
Other capabilities: Prompt-injection blocking, secrets and malicious-content detectors, configurable policies/recipes, audit reporting.
Banking fit / caveat: Closest managed option for sanitized content plus security screening; assess Private Cloud/Edge, retention, region, contract, and pricing.

License or cost: Commercial; SaaS and self-hosted-container options. Contact vendor for production pricing.
PII masking: Data-leakage prevention includes PII protection; verify configured action provides required redaction rather than detection/blocking only.
Other capabilities: Prompt-attack defense, content moderation, malicious-link detection, agent behavior defense, tool allow/deny policies.
Banking fit / caveat: Strong enterprise security candidate; confirm sensitive data handling, deployment boundary, and exact redaction behavior.

License or cost: Managed, usage-based service; not open source.
Model-specific: AWS-managed; supports Bedrock use and ApplyGuardrail API. Check model/region support for your integration.
PII masking: Can block or mask PII/sensitive entities and custom regex patterns.
Other capabilities: Content/topic/word filters, prompt-attack filters, contextual grounding, automated reasoning checks.
Banking fit / caveat: Strong option if AWS is acceptable; check supported regions/models, costs, and data-processing boundary.

License or cost: Managed service; product page lists 2M tokens/month free, then $0.10 per additional million tokens. Verify current billing terms.
Model-specific: Model- and cloud-agnostic REST API; also integrates with Google services.
PII masking: Sensitive Data Protection integration screens sensitive data; confirm required redaction behavior and configuration.
Other capabilities: Prompt injection/jailbreak screening, sensitive-data leakage controls, harmful content, malware and unsafe URLs.
Banking fit / caveat: Worth evaluating with Gemini; confirm data residency, redaction behavior, and any additional Sensitive Data Protection charges.

License or cost: Managed Azure service; limited F0 tier and paid S0 tier.
Model-specific: Screening API is not tied to one model provider.
PII masking: Does not provide a complete PII masking pipeline by itself; would need another service or custom component.
Other capabilities: Content moderation, Prompt Shields, groundedness detection, task adherence, protected-material detection.
Banking fit / caveat: Partial fit only if PII masking is a requirement; useful for content/prompt safety in Azure.

License or cost: Open-source firewall code; scanner/model assets may have separate terms or costs.
Model-specific: Can scan workflows using different target LLMs; some scanners depend on specific models/services.
PII masking: Experimental PII scanner detects/blocks; it does not redact text.
Other capabilities: Prompt-injection scanning, agent-trace/alignment checks, regex/custom scanners, code security scanning.
Banking fit / caveat: Useful supplementary security scanner, not a standalone PII-masking solution.

License or cost: Models released under Apache 2.0; local hosting requires compute.
Model-specific: Guardian judge uses IBM Granite models but can assess prompts/responses/tool calls from other agents.
PII masking: No built-in PII masking pipeline; custom criteria can judge whether text contains sensitive information.
Other capabilities: Jailbreak/harm checks, RAG groundedness/relevance, tool-call hallucination detection, custom criteria.
Banking fit / caveat: Useful local risk-detection model, but not a complete guardrail framework or masker.

License or cost: MIT license; repository archived July 9, 2026 and no longer maintained.
Model-specific: Model-agnostic pipeline; some scanners use separate models.
Other capabilities: Prompt-injection, secrets, toxicity, sanitization and output scanners.
Banking fit / caveat: Not recommended for a new production banking system because the project is archived.
